crossRefs.note: O earth, earth, earth, hear Yahweh’s word!
Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”

translations.web: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.
translations.bsb: O earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry for help never be laid to rest.
translations.kjv: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.
translations.asv: O earth, cover not thou my blood, And let my cry have no resting -place.
